standard.summary: 触发低分辨率反传的 sigma 阈值。
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: The sigma threshold that triggers low-resolution backward.
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: 触发低分辨率反传的 sigma 阈值。仅 sigma > 该值的 timestep 会下采样。推荐 0.5（可调 0.1~0.9）。

advanced_en.principle: Sigma threshold that triggers low-resolution backward. Only timesteps with sigma above this value get downsampled. Recommended 0.5 (tunable 0.1~0.9).
